about.description: R25 is a multi-chain RWA tokenization protocol building the "rcTokens" family — RWA-backed yieldcoins. Product line: rcUSD (conservative MMF-backed dollar, $1 peg, on Sui/Polygon), rcUSDp (yield-bearing version), rcHY (higher yield from tokenized PE/credit), ibUSD (illiquid higher-yield), and VRPC family on Pharos (VRPC-Weekly + VRPC-SemiYearly + VRPC-Quarterly Variable Real Private Credit pools). The TopNod wallet collaboration offers fixed 1-year yields of ~12% base APY plus 2% boost for the first 3 months. R25 brings yield through tokenized money market funds and structured private-credit exposures including renewable energy, emerging tech, and disruptive industries.
about.registryInfo: R25 is a decentralized finance protocol building institutional-grade tokenized assets supported by real-world assets. Focus on risk management, credit enhancement, and on-chain transparency. Founding member of the Pharos RealFi Alliance (alongside Chainlink, Asseto Finance, Ember, Faroo, LayerZero, Re7 Labs, TopNod, and Centrifuge). Multi-chain deployment: rcUSD/rcUSDp on Sui (Bluefin/Ember vault collaboration via TopNod wallet), rcUSD+ on Polygon, VRPC family on Pharos. Audited (Sui Audit Report + Polygon Audit Report available on website).

fees.revenueNotes: R25 retains the yield spread between underlying MMF/credit returns and the rebase/yield paid to rcToken holders. Specific bps not publicly disclosed at audit date. Source: https://www.r25.xyz/
